title: An Unpleasant Homecoming
summary: Naomi is on Saint Barnabus for a friend's wedding when the bride's father is stabbed.
method: The killer manipulated her alibi by swapping phones with someone who took videos at the wedding. The killer took advantage of the blinding sunset to pretend like she was someone else.
motive: The killer found out that the victim lied about who started the fire years ago.
